'''Prototype Bonadan braided belts''' were an item of medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They were [[Brown (disambiguation)|brown]] in color with a metallic rimmed [[Black (disambiguation)|black]] belt buckle. They shared a name with [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]].<ref name="KOTOR">[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]</ref>
